info.title: API.SH: GBIF
info.description: The GBIF API from API.SH: public GBIF data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One occurrence record in full: taxon and classification, date, coordinates and uncertainty, locality, dataset and publisher, institution, collection and catalogue number, licence, media, data quality issues and every original field. Each record names who recorded and who identified it (with their ORCID or other ids when published, and the identification date); records from iNaturalist also carry the observer's username.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/gbif-occurrence

get.description:
Biodiversity occurrence records (specimens, observations, samples) from thousands of institutions with GBIF's filters: taxon, country, area, dates, basis of record, dataset, publisher, IUCN category, media, licence... Each record has taxon and classification, date, coordinates and uncertainty, place, dataset, institution and catalogue number, licence, media and data quality issues. `facet` adds counts by field (set `limit=0` for counts only). Each record names who recorded and who identified it (with their ORCID or other ids when published, and the identification date); records from iNaturalist also carry the observer's username. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page (GBIF serves the first 100,000 records of a query).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/gbif-occurrences

get.description:
Names in the GBIF Backbone Taxonomy (or any checklist) by words or filters: key, scientific and canonical name, authorship, rank, taxonomic status, accepted name, full classification, common names, habitats, threat statuses and number of occurrences. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
